|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Baragwin (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-62-Baragwin-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Baragwin (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Baragwin (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Lost if a Starting Effect on table. Your non-alien characters are power and forfeit = 0. If present at a battleground site, your Force drains at battleground sites where you have two aliens are +1, and when you deploy an alien, retrieve 1 Force.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 4). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Baragwin (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “This character is lost” for “Lost”, “Your non-alien characters at sites” for “Your non-alien characters” and “whenever” for “when” (it adds the credit line “(Origninal Concept by Corey Faherty - Nationals 2006)”, typo as published): “This character is lost if a Starting Effect on table. Your non-alien characters at sites are power and forfeit = 0. If present at a battleground site, your Force drains at battleground sites where you have two aliens are +1, and whenever you deploy an alien, retrieve 1 Force. (Origninal Concept by Corey Faherty - Nationals 2006)”<ref name="cl-1261_62-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
